quotes.text: ANOTE EL CÓDIGO DE IDENTIFICACIÓN DEL CÓNYUGE, PADRE Y MADRE DE CADA PERSONA MIEMBRO DEL HOGAR. SI NO CORRESPONDE ANOTE "00"
¿Algún miembro de este hogar recibió remesas durante los últimos 12 meses?
¿Podría informarme sobre los ingresos mensuales que habitualmente recibe?.
Durante el último mes, ¿cuál fue el valor de lo producido o comprado por este ...[ESTABLECIMIENTO O NEGOCIO]... para la venta que fue destinado al consumo del hogar ?

assessments.reasoning:
1. de_jure_vs_de_facto (True): Section 1 Q7 records marital status, Q5 links spouses present in the household via line numbers (or '00' if absent), and Section 6 Parte E Q2 collects remittance information. Combining marital status with partner presence/absence in the roster and remittance data allows distinguishing de jure from de facto female-headed households.
2. unpartnered_mother_child_units (True): Section 1 Q5 explicitly records the line number of each member's mother and spouse, allowing unpartnered mother-child units to be identified within complex or extended households.
3. women_maintained_by_provider (True): Section 6 Parte E collects individual income for all household members aged 10+, enabling identification of the main economic provider/maintainer of the household independently of who is declared as household head.
4. mother_child_unit_activity (False): The survey records consumption and production exclusively at the household aggregate level (e.g., Section 7 Parte B Q8 refers to 'consumo del hogar') and lacks care or time-use data, so mother-child units cannot be linked to their own separate consumption, production, or care activities.
